lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਚਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਲ ਪੂਰਈਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: har har usatat karai din raatee rakh rakh charan har taal pooraeeaa ||5||
lines.translation: I praise the Lord, day and night, moving my feet to the beat of the drum. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਾਲ ਰਸਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kai ra(n)g rataa man gaavai ras rasaal ras sabad ravaeeaa ||
lines.translation: Imbued with the Lord's Love, my mind sings His Praise, joyfully chanting the Shabad, the source of nectar and bliss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਧਾਰ ਚੁਐ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਆ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: nij ghar dhaar chuai at niramal jin peeaa tin hee sukh laheeaa ||6||
lines.translation: The stream of immaculate purity flows through the home of the self within; one who drinks it in, finds peace. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਕ ਬਾਲੂ ਘਰ ਉਸਰਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: manahath karam karai abhimaanee jiu baalak baaloo ghar usaraeeaa ||
lines.translation: The stubborn-minded, egotistical, proud-minded person performs rituals, but these are like sand castles built by children.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਲਹਰਿ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਾਗਰ ਕੀ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਢਹਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: aavai lahar samu(n)d saagar kee khin mahi bhi(n)n bhi(n)n dhahi paeeaa ||7||
lines.translation: When the waves of the ocean come in, they crumble and dissolve in an instant. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਖੇਲਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har sar saagar har hai aape ihu jag hai sabh khel khelaeeaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord is the pool, and the Lord Himself is the ocean; this world is all a play which He has staged.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗ ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਰਮਈਆ ॥੮॥੩॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: jiu jal tara(n)g jal jalahi samaavahi naanak aape aap ramaeeaa ||8||3||6||
lines.translation: As the waves of water merge into the water again, O Nanak, so does He merge into Himself. ||8||3||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਚੈ ਮਨਿ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਤਨਿ ਭਸਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur parachai man mu(n)draa paaee gur kaa sabad tan bhasam driRaeeaa ||
lines.translation: My mind wears the ear-rings of the True Guru's acquaintance; I apply the ashes of the Word of the Guru's Shabad to my body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਮਰ ਪਿੰਡ ਭਏ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੋਊ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: amar pi(n)d bhae saadhoo sa(n)g janam maran dooo mit gaeeaa ||1||
lines.translation: My body has become immortal, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Both birth and death have come to an end for me. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man saadhasa(n)gat mil raheeaa ||
lines.translation: O my mind, remain united with the Saadh Sangat.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਧਸੂਦਨ ਮਾਧਉ ਮੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਣ ਪਖਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kripaa karahu madhasoodan maadhau mai khin khin saadhoo charan pakhaeeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Be merciful to me, O Lord; each and every instant, let me wash the Feet of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਜੈ ਗਿਰਸਤੁ ਭਇਆ ਬਨ ਵਾਸੀ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਟਿਕੈ ਨ ਟਿਕਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tajai girasat bhaiaa ban vaasee ik khin manooaa tikai na tikaeeaa ||
lines.translation: Forsaking family life, he wanders in the forest, but his mind does not remain at rest, even for an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਧਾਇ ਤਦੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵਈਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: dhaavat dhaai tade ghar aavai har har saadhoo saran pavaeeaa ||2||
lines.translation: The wandering mind returns home, only when it seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's Holy people. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੀਆ ਪੂਤ ਛੋਡਿ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਆਸਾ ਆਸ ਮਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਰਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dheeaa poot chhod sa(n)niaasee aasaa aas man bahut karaeeaa ||
lines.translation: The Sannyaasi renounces his daughters and sons, but his mind still conjures up all sorts of hopes and desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਆਸ ਕਰੈ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa aas karai nahee boojhai gur kai sabad niraas sukh laheeaa ||3||
lines.translation: With these hopes and desires, he still does not understand, that only through the Word of the Guru's Shabad does one become free of desires, and find peace. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਪਜੀ ਤਰਕ ਦਿਗੰਬਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਮਨੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਚਲਿ ਚਲਿ ਗਵਨੁ ਕਰਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: upajee tarak diga(n)bar hoaa man dah dis chal chal gavan karaeeaa ||
lines.translation: When detachment from the world wells up within, he become a naked hermit, but still, his mind roams, wanders and rambles in the ten directions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਵਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਨਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧ ਦਇਆ ਘਰੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: prabhavan karai boojhai nahee trisanaa mil sa(n)g saadh daiaa ghar laheeaa ||4||
lines.translation: He wanders around, but his desires are not satisfied; joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he finds the house of kindness and compassion. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਣ ਸਿਧ ਸਿਖਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਚੇਟਕ ਚੇਟਕਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasan sidh sikhahi bahutere man maagahi ridh sidh chetak chetakaeeaa ||
lines.translation: The Siddhas learn many Yogis postures, but their minds still yearn for riches, miraculous powers and energy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: tripat sa(n)tokh man saa(n)t na aavai mil saadhoo tripat har naam sidh paeeaa ||5||
lines.translation: Satisfaction, contentment and tranquility do not come to their minds; but meeting the Holy Saints, they are satisfied, and through the Name of the Lord, spiritual perfection is attained. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਸੇਤਜ ਉਤਭੁਜ ਸਭਿ ਵਰਨ ਰੂਪ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)daj jeraj setaj utabhuj sabh varan roop jee ja(n)t upaeeaa ||
lines.translation: Life is born from the egg, from the womb, from sweat and from the earth; God created the beings and creatures of all colors and forms.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੈ ਸੋ ਉਬਰੈ ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਸੂਦੁ ਵੈਸੁ ਚੰਡਾਲੁ ਚੰਡਈਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: saadhoo saran parai so ubarai khatree braahaman sood vais cha(n)daal cha(n)daeeaa ||6||
lines.translation: One who seeks the Sanctuary of the Holy is saved, whether he is a Kh'shaatriya, a Brahmin, a Soodra, a Vaishya or the most untouchable of the untouchables. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਾ ਜੈਦੇਉ ਕੰਬੀਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਅਉਜਾਤਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਚਮਿਆਰੁ ਚਮਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naamaa jaideu ka(n)beer trilochan aujaat ravidaas chamiaar chamaeeaa ||
lines.translation: Naam Dayv, Jai Dayv, Kabeer, Trilochan and Ravi Daas the low-caste leather-worker,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨਾ ਜਟੁ ਸੈਣੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦਈਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: jo jo milai saadhoo jan sa(n)gat dhan dha(n)naa jat sain miliaa har daeeaa ||7||
lines.translation: blessed Dhanna and Sain; all those who joined the humble Saadh Sangat, met the Merciful Lord. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kee har paij rakhaaee bhagat vachhal a(n)geekaar karaeeaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord protects the honor of His humble servants; He is the Lover of His devotees - He makes them His own.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਖਈਆ ॥੮॥੪॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saran pare jagajeevan har har kirapaa dhaar rakhaeeaa ||8||4||7||
lines.translation: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Life of the world, who has showered His Mercy upon him, and saved him. ||8||||4||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਉਠੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਮਨਿ ਤੀਰ ਲਗਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar piaas uthee prabh keree sun gur bachan man teer lagaeeaa ||
lines.translation: The thirst for God has welled up deep within me; hearing the Word of the Guru's Teachings, my mind is pierced by His arrow.
